migration_flags.description: Early payment discount feature introduced in v16. Fields absent in v14/v15. Migration: set early_discount=False for all existing payment term records; no data loss.

The 'balance' option was removed from the value selection in v16+. In v19 only 'percent' and 'fixed' exist. The last line is implicitly the balance. Any v14/v15 line with value='balance' must be converted to value='percent' with value_amount=100.

Old integer day_of_the_month field replaced by delay_type selection 'days_end_of_month_on_the' plus days_next_month Char field. Migration scripts must map legacy day_of_the_month values to the new structure.
company_id is optional. Blank terms are shared globally. Parent-of domain enforced. Cross-company invoice use automatically resolves currency from invoicing company.
Stored computed field. Auto-set from company country: BE->mixed, NL->excluded, all others->included. No manual migration needed; recompute will set correct values.

key_findings.installment_engine: _compute_terms() iterates line_ids, rounds each non-balance line in both currencies, assigns full residual to last line; early discount pre-computed separately with country-specific tax treatment (included/excluded/mixed)
key_findings.due_date_logic: _get_due_date() on term line: four delay_type modes using relativedelta and date_utils.end_of(); result propagated to account.move.line.date_maturity via _compute_needed_terms()

early_discount_computation_modes.included: discount_balance = round(total * (1 - pct)) — tax portion discounted
early_discount_computation_modes.excluded: discount_balance = round(total - untaxed * pct) — only untaxed base discounted
early_discount_computation_modes.mixed: same formula as excluded but discount applied always upon invoice posting

key_findings.validation: _check_lines() requires percent lines sum to 100.0 at Payment Terms decimal precision; early_discount requires exactly one line, discount_percentage>0, discount_days>0
key_findings.currency_rounding: Each non-balance line rounded via currency.round(); cash_rounding.compute_difference() applied if configured; balance line absorbs all residual — no net rounding error
key_findings.move_integration: account.move._compute_needed_terms() calls payment term _compute_terms() on invoice date change; each output line creates frozendict key with date_maturity, discount_date; stored on display_type='payment_term' move lines
